name: A. C. Huidekoper
role: Custer Trail Cattle Co. investor and horse raiser, of Meadville, Pa.
bio: A. C. Huidekoper of Meadville, Pennsylvania, was heavily invested in the Custer Trail Cattle Company, and in 1884 the paper reported Holstein cattle he had bought in Holland. In December 1884 he was among those who requested the meeting of Little Missouri stockmen. He spent several weeks in summer 1885 with his two sons looking after his Bad Lands cattle and horse interests, and that November predicted a bright future for raising high-priced horses and planned a barn at the Logging camp. In October 1886 the paper recalled his opinion that natural gas could be found by boring in the Bad Lands.
